purpose: Check lightweight training comprehension and provide pass/fail feedback.
conditional_logic: Avoid hiding quiz questions unless scoring impact is approved.
confirmations: Show pass/fail confirmation only after score threshold approval.
notifications: Send results to training owner; avoid unnecessary score exposure to broad admin recipients.
feeds: Quiz Add-On settings and result dashboard; no certification or LMS claim without separate approval.
embedding_target: Training page or internal learner portal.
data_retention_notes: Identified learner result. Retention should match training record policy; do not treat as anonymous.
risks: Scoring changes can affect displayed historical results.
Hidden quiz questions still count as incorrect.
Not suitable as secure exam/proctoring system without separate controls.

spam_settings.recommended: Use layered spam protection appropriate for public feedback forms.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels required. Scale choices need plain-language labels.
